description: SEC EDGAR Exhibit 21 subsidiary lists (Form 10-K) for the FactLot Registry. Not downloaded by the collector: the SEC asks for a declared User-Agent of its own (FACTLOT_SEC_USER_AGENT), so scripts/registry/sec_edgar.py fetches these files. See docs/registry/data-policy.md and the review record in docs/registry/sources/sec-edgar-exhibit-21.md.

sources.publisher: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (EDGAR), filed by each registrant
sources.license: Public filing on www.sec.gov. SEC website policy (privacy-information page, 'Website Dissemination'): information presented on sec.gov is public information and may be copied or further distributed without the SEC's permission; citation of the SEC as the source is asked for. Filers' contents are the registrants' own disclosures
sources.ai_use: Not addressed by the SEC; recorded unknown
sources.redistribution: Permitted: sec.gov information may be copied or further distributed without permission. Attribution: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, EDGAR; the filing trust or registrant
sources.notes: Terms reviewed and downloads confirmed with scripts/registry/sec_edgar.py. 'verified' is false only so that the generic collector never fetches this source: it has no files listed, and the SEC's fair access policy asks for the requester's own declared User-Agent (FACTLOT_SEC_USER_AGENT). One registry source per registrant (sec-edgar-ex21-<CIK>), latest 10-K Exhibit 21 of 122 chosen registrants on 2026-11-04. Same fair-access handling as the CMBS source.
